thread:
maria (People Ops): Quick idea — a compact 3x5 goal card template for self-reviews and manager notes. Short, scannable, and usable in 1:1s. Example and manager prompts below. :sparkles:
jamal (Eng): love that. can you share an example we can copy into Notion?
maria (People Ops): sure — here's a single-card template you can copy:
```
Goal: Reduce average inference cost per request by 20% (Q2)
Metric: tokens_per_dollar, target = 20% improvement vs baseline
Key actions: quantize models + prefix cache + batch tuning
Manager ask: blockers? cross-team deps? support needed by EOW
```
alana (Manager): neat. for managers maybe add 3 quick prompts to guide feedback: 1) observed impact, 2) growth angle, 3) suggested next-step. short bullets only.
luis (IC): can we make a one-line headline for each card? e.g., "Cost: -20% — caching + quant" so reviewers can skim.
maria (People Ops): yes — recommendation: top line = 15–20 char headline, second = one-line metric, third = manager ask. i'll add an example:
```
Headline: Cost: -20% (inference)
Metric: tokens/$ +20% by Aug 15
Ask: needs infra time + Dedicated GPU slot in week 3
```
jamal (Eng): also include a tiny section for risks/regressions — one sentence max. helps when managers approve.
maria (People Ops): good call. tiny risk note optional on the back of the card. i'll make a Notion template and a copy-paste Slack snippet.
peggy-bot: Reminder: Q2 self-review window opens in 7 days. Templates available in #people-ops -> pinned resources.
alana (Manager): can you post the Notion link when it's ready? i'll drop it into our sprint retro.
maria (People Ops): will do. i'll upload the template + two manager cheat-lines (how to leave inline comments) by EOD. thanks for the input! :thumbsup:
